goal: Kontrolliertes Neuordnen vorhandener Browser-Draft-Elemente ohne Drag-and-drop-Zwang implementieren. Reihenfolge nur schrittweise hoch/runter, browserlokal und ohne Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Platzierten Draft-Elementen stehen deterministische Hoch-/Runter-Controls zur Verfügung. Randpositionen sind gesperrt und der Fokus bleibt nach dem Schritt am verschobenen Element.

direct_dependencies: I133 duplicate capability is confirmed on main
existing choice-option reorder pattern provides the interaction precedent
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run existing test_browser_shell.py as narrow browser-shell regression
first element cannot move up; last element cannot move down
one action changes order by exactly one position
focus returns to an enabled order control of the moved element
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
new screenshot evidence because this slice reuses existing button/layout patterns and is not a visual milestone
risks: reordering must not mutate draft or option identities
edge controls must not leave focus on a disabled button
preview order must remain derived from the same draftElements sequence
no drag-and-drop-only interaction may be introduced
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: a draft element can move exactly one position up or down in browser memory
editor row order and preview order update together
focus stays with the moved element on an enabled reorder control
